name: Fertile Ground
oracle_text:
Enchant land
Whenever enchanted land is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional one mana of any color.
blocked_sentences: Whenever enchanted land is tapped for mana, its controller adds an additional one mana of any color.

needs.what: an add_mana_on_tap payload meaning 'one mana of any color', chosen by the tapping player each time the triggered mana ability resolves (605.1b), e.g. add_mana: {"any_color": 1}, with the mana solver and payment treating it as a wildcard pip
needs.why_existing_wont_do: add_mana_on_tap with tapped_permanent {attached: true} covers the enchanted-land trigger (Wild Growth, Utopia Sprawl), but its add_mana accepts only a literal production string or {"chosen_color_of": "self"}; the loader (_validate_add_mana_on_tap) refuses any other dynamic form, and player_statics._mana_added runs inside cost payment where no choice can be asked. A literal '{G}' or a chosen colour would each be a different, narrower card
